column1: # The census of tests//negative/coverage:census_* (test 46). src/a: one library; src/b: one failed (line floor 0); src/c: the floor is the lowest library (c1, first); src/d: an old floor above the measurement survives (under floor); src/e: one library without a branch number (no branch floor); src/f: a library with no line (0/0) sets nothing; src/g: a pinned row, whose measured floors (shown) ignore its 0/0 library g2; and a test package.
